idea: A warm natural-pink crescent on glossy black with two sparse ivory pearls; bold, quiet, asymmetric composition suited to the broad brush.
hypothesis: A restrained three-element composition can look deliberate and elegant without fine lines.
method: Dense black coat; drill circular window at (510,1250), radius 120; black offset masking disc at (605,1205), radius 110; white stationary pearls at (700,800) and (365,1800).
constraints: Painting-stage result only; no curing or persistence claim. Mark/contact offset approximately -120 y. Every accepted cycle must be a visibly significant improvement in beauty.
